title: Maximum Number of Occurrences of a Substring
summary: Determine the highest frequency of any substring in a given string, adhering to the constraints that the substring's unique character count does not exceed maxLetters, and its length falls within the range of minSize to maxSize, inclusive.
statement: Determine the highest frequency of any substring in a given string, adhering to the constraints that the substring's unique character count does not exceed maxLetters, and its length falls within the range of minSize to maxSize, inclusive.
constraints: Count substrings having at most max_letters distinct characters.
Return the greatest occurrence count among lengths min_size through max_size.
hints: Only min_size needs counting: every occurrence of a longer valid substring contains a valid min_size prefix.
Count each min_size window whose distinct-character count is within the limit.
A longer substring cannot occur more often than its fixed prefix, so it cannot improve the optimum.
editorial: A longer substring cannot occur more often than its fixed prefix, so it cannot improve the optimum.

Substring aa occurs three times, the maximum frequency.
